There's another reason people keep that card. And it's parked right outside.
Most Costco warehouses have a gas station. Only members can fill up there, and the price is usually lower than at the stations down the road. In fiscal year 2026, Costco estimates it saved its members about 3.2 billion dollars on gas, compared with other stations in its markets.
Think about what that does. A family that fills up at Costco every week can make back the cost of a basic membership in a few months of gas alone. And while they're there, why not go inside? The gas station works just like the hot dog. It's one more reason to show up.
Then there's the return policy. Costco promises that members can return almost anything they're not happy with. There are a few limits, like 90 days for most electronics. But the promise even covers the membership itself. If you decide it isn't worth it, Costco says it will refund your fee.
That sounds risky. But it sends a powerful message: we're so sure you'll come back that we'll let you leave for free. And most people never ask.
